stories.title: Hidden Electrical Dangers Inside Your Walls
stories.description: Common household electrical hazards that develop silently behind walls and often go unnoticed until serious damage occurs.

scenes.hook_text: This danger is already inside your home
scenes.visual_prompt: Quiet modern home interior at night, empty room, soft warm lighting, static tripod framing, very slow subtle push-in, calm but uneasy atmosphere
scenes.visual_reference: Establishes that hidden electrical dangers exist inside normal homes without visible warning signs
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, cartoon, fast motion
scenes.narration: Some of the most dangerous electrical problems are completely invisible.

scenes.visual_prompt: Interior wall with light switch and power socket, minimal modern design, neutral lighting, locked-off camera, completely stable frame
scenes.visual_reference: Shows common areas where people expect electrical danger, highlighting that the real risk is not visible here
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, cartoon
scenes.narration: They don’t appear at switches or sockets where people expect them.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cutaway view of a wall revealing electrical wiring behind drywall, clean technical visualization, slow left-to-right camera slide, stable motion
scenes.visual_reference: Reveals electrical wiring hidden inside walls where heat buildup and insulation failure can occur unseen
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo, fantasy
scenes.narration: Most electrical hazards stay hidden deep inside walls.

scenes.visual_prompt: Old electrical wiring bundled inside wall cavity, cracked insulation and crowded cables, macro perspective, slow gentle push-in
scenes.visual_reference: Illustrates the danger of aging wires and overloaded circuits that can slowly build heat and trigger electrical fires
scenes.negative_prompt: hands, people, sparks, fire, text, watermark, logo
scenes.narration: Aging wires and overloaded circuits can quietly build heat over time.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unsafe DIY electrical repair with taped and loose wires, object-only close-up, static camera, no people visible
scenes.visual_reference: Shows the risk of improper DIY electrical repairs that increase resistance and overheating behind walls
scenes.narration: Improper DIY repairs often increase the danger instead of fixing it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Flickering ceiling light and subtle warm wall glow near an outlet, locked-off camera, no camera movement
scenes.visual_reference: Demonstrates early warning signs of hidden electrical danger such as overheating wires causing flickering lights and warm walls
scenes.narration: Flickering lights or warm walls are early warning signs.

scenes.visual_prompt: Residential electrical panel and wiring, clean and orderly, calm reassuring lighting, static inspection-style shot, quiet atmosphere
scenes.visual_reference: Represents prevention of hidden electrical dangers through inspection and early detection before failure occurs
scenes.narration: Most electrical dangers are preventable if they’re found early.
